about: The check before acting (format description, section 20), on a device without SLH-DSA.

cases.name: an action within the slip
no passkey trusted

problems.message: The check before acting must be told which passkeys it trusts. A slip signed by any other key allows nothing.

cases.name: an action over the total

breaches.message: With this action the total would be 110 GBP. The slip's limit is 100 GBP: over by 10.
The slip asks for the person's own approval of this action, and none was handed to this check.

cases.name: an action that needs an approval, with it
an action that needs an approval, without it

breaches.message: The slip asks for the person's own approval of this action, and none was handed to this check.

cases.name: an approval for something else

problems.message: The approval was given for something else.

cases.name: an action dated before the last stub

problems.message: The action is dated before the last stub in its chain.

cases.name: a second action within the hour
an action with no amount

breaches.message: The slip sets a limit or a condition in "GBP" for this action, and the action gives no amount in that unit.

cases.name: an action with no service

breaches.message: The slip asks for the other side to countersign this action, and the action names no service whose keys the slip gives. No countersignature could be given.

cases.name: a third action, within the hour and in all

breaches.message: This would be action number 3 of this kind under the slip. The slip allows 2.
With this action there would be 3 such actions in any hour. The slip allows 2.
